title: The Antikythera mechanism
hook: More than two thousand years ago, someone built a machine that looks impossibly modern.

title: The Great Molasses Flood
hook: A city street was once hit by a deadly wave made of molasses.

title: The Dancing Plague of 1518
hook: Hundreds of people once danced for days, and nobody really knows why.

title: The Wow! signal
hook: In 1977, a radio telescope detected a signal so strange that an astronomer wrote one word beside it: wow.

title: The Library of Alexandria
hook: The most famous lost library in history may not have vanished the way most people think.

title: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge
hook: This bridge twisted itself apart on camera, and the reason changed engineering forever.

title: The eruption of Krakatoa
hook: One volcanic eruption was heard thousands of miles away and changed skies around the world.

title: The London Beer Flood
hook: London once had a flood made of beer, and it turned deadly.

title: Operation Paul Bunyan
hook: A dispute over one tree triggered one of the strangest military operations of the Cold War.

title: The first transatlantic telegraph cable
hook: Before satellites, engineers tried to connect continents with a cable laid across the ocean floor.

title: The Dyatlov Pass incident
hook: Nine experienced hikers died in the mountains, and the scene they left behind fueled decades of theories.

title: The 1908 Tunguska event
hook: An explosion flattened a vast forest, but it left no impact crater.

title: The first vending machine
hook: Vending machines are far older than you probably think.

title: The invention of the microwave oven
hook: The microwave oven exists because an engineer noticed something melting in his pocket.

title: The first computer mouse
hook: The first computer mouse looked nothing like the sleek devices we use today.

title: The history of GPS
hook: Your phone can find you because of clocks so accurate that relativity has to be corrected for.

title: The origin of QR codes
hook: QR codes were not invented for restaurants, payments, or phones.

title: The birth of the shipping container
hook: One simple metal box quietly transformed the global economy.

title: How undersea internet cables work
hook: Almost everything you do online depends on cables lying on the ocean floor.

title: Why airplane windows are round
hook: Airplane windows became rounded because square ones helped cause deadly accidents.
